plan.design: ESM-2 masked-marginal delta log-likelihood (E1) scan: score all 19 single substitutions at positions 12, 43, 24 plus focused analog subsets at 22, 19 (70 run_model calls, one candidate per call since masked-marginal deltas are non-additive across positions). Rank scored candidates by E1 descending. Then query the E3 historical oracle on the top ~11 newly-scored candidates (excluding the 5 known-winner anchors) plus re-measure the 5 known-winner anchors (S12T, S43T, D24E, N22S, M19L) as internal positive controls = 16 queries. Final top-5 ordered by measured fitness (E3).
controls: Positive controls: re-measure the 5 known-winner anchors (S12T, S43T, D24E, N22S, M19L) whose prior-run measured fitness is known (0.513, 0.175, 0.136, 0.126, 0.117) to confirm oracle consistency. Reference signal: prior-run Spearman rho(E1,E3)=0.224 (ESM-2 zero-shot is weak but non-negative).
plan.observation_metric: Measured fitness (E3, real historical DMS from ProteinGym SDA_BACSU_Tsuboyama_2023_1PV0) for each queried candidate; final top-5 members' measured fitness and whether each is >= the 75th percentile (top quartile) of the full 834-candidate measured pool.
plan.refutation_condition: H1 falsified if Spearman rho(E1, E3) over the queried candidates is <= 0 (E1 does not positively order measured fitness). H2 falsified if fewer than 3 of the final top-5 are in the true top quartile (>= 75th percentile of the 834-candidate pool measured fitness).
